payload.body: Foundation committed to branch rust-rewrite-foundation (e071664): 169 new files — crates/{protocol,schema,codegen,store,server}, conformance fixtures, internal/rust-rewrite maps, Cargo workspace, rust CI. 343 tests green. Deliberately did NOT commit pre-existing modified TS files (CHANGELOG/README/docs/apps-server-src that were modified by other automation before this session) nor my small tweaks to shared already-modified files (AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md/package.json/.gitignore/gateway.ts Delta reorder) — those carry unrelated edits and can be staged selectively later.
